newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA NOON BONDS LANGUISH, AWAIT M3, CREDIT DATA.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA NOON BONDS LANGUISH, AWAIT M3, CREDIT DATA.

text.p: 1021 GMT - Noon bonds languish at softer levels with all eyes on June money supply and credit numbers due out at 1500 GMT. Rand off worst morning levels after Reserve Bank showed its hand earlier and amid some exporter interest, traders say.
* Benchmark R150 loan at 14.045 pct from 13.995 pct at 1400 GMT Friday.
* Bond mkt players adopting wait-and-see attitude ahead of M3 figures later and other barrage of data this week including inflation, trade and reserves.
* View that M3 and credit data crucial in determining whether Reserve Bank will move on cutting interest rates in next few weeks.
* Rand at 4.5710/5740 vs dlr from morning weakest bid of 4.5750 -- a fresh six-month low. Unit at 4.5635/5665 at 1400 GMT on Friday.
* Dealers see little scope for currency to strenghten during week in face of rampant dollar which at seven-and-a-half year high vs mark and bearish local close on Friday.
* Range of 4.5680 to 4.5750 against greenback seen in afternoon.
